name: @pipeworx/mcp-data-gr

tools.name: search_datasets
tools.description: Search Greece Open Data (Greece) for datasets by keyword. Returns each dataset's id/name, title, organization, and its resources (each with a resource_id for query_resource).

tools.name: dataset
tools.description: Show full metadata for one Greece Open Data dataset by id or name (from search_datasets), including all resources and their resource_ids.

tools.name: query_resource
tools.description: Pull rows from a tabular Greece Open Data resource (CKAN DataStore) by resource_id (from a dataset's resources). Optional full-text q, limit, offset. Note: only resources with the DataStore enabled are queryable.

q.description: Optional full-text filter over the rows.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-data-gr forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the data-gr pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
